requirementSummary: DX Coil Height must update immediately after every edit, but the ticket also states that DX Coil Height must never update after an edit.
businessRules: DX Coil Height must update immediately after every edit.
DX Coil Height must never update after an edit.
ambiguities: The ticket contains contradictory requirements: one requires DX Coil Height to update immediately after every edit, while another requires it to never update after an edit. It is unclear which behavior is intended.
